description:
Other lines for Flood, Nigeria, 2 September 2024 (FL20240902NGA): 254 features merged from 4 source layers. Lines layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Satellite detected water extent in Dikwa Town, Dikwa Local Government Area, Borno state, Nigeria as of 9 and 19 September 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-in-dikwa-town-dikwa-local-government-area-borno-state-nigeria-as-of-9-and-19-)
- [Satellite detected water extents from 9 to 13 November 2024 over Nigeria](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-from-9-to-13-november-2024-over-nigeria)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.
